ABOUT.TITLE: Lidia.txt
ABOUT.TEXT:
Hey! I'm a junior developer focused on Java and Spring Boot on the backend, while also comfortable building interfaces with Angular on the frontend.

If I had to describe myself: I'm hard-working, easy to work with, and a firm believer that good humor makes teamwork way better (and makes fixing bugs a lot less painful). I love coding, learning new tools on the fly, and sticking with a problem until everything clicks.

Coming from a professional esports background, discipline, real teamwork, and staying cool under pressure are second nature to me. Right now, I'm looking for a team where I can learn from experienced developers, put in the work, and contribute from day one.

EXPERIENCE.TITLE: Work Experience
EXPERIENCE.INNOVASUR_DETAIL:
During my 3-month internship, the first month focused on training and getting familiar with the technologies used in the project, primarily Angular and NestJS, through Udemy courses. Over the following two months, I developed an LMS (Learning Management System) platform from scratch, working autonomously and without using AI. The project includes the core features of an educational platform, such as course creation and management, lesson and content authoring, assignment submission and grading, grade viewing, and user management. Key features and implemented technologies include:
- Frontend development with Angular, primarily utilizing DaisyUI alongside Tailwind CSS and CSS for the interface and custom styling, as well as testing Angular Material.
- Backend development with NestJS, structuring the application architecture and its various functionalities.
- Implementation of a PDF document viewer to streamline assignment grading.
- Development of a global statistics system for teachers, using Chart.js for data visualization.
- Implementation of an in-app messaging system between teachers and students.
- MinIO integration as Object Storage for file management and storage.
- Implementation of authentication and authorization using JWT, adhering to security best practices and standards.
- End-to-end full-stack development, contributing across both frontend and backend modules.

ESPORTS.TITLE: E-sports details
ESPORTS.DETAILS:
High-performance competitive career (2022–2024) in the official VCT Game Changers EMEA circuit, competing at the highest European professional level representing tier-one organizations such as MAD Lions KOI, Giants Gaming, and Rebels Gaming.

Officially honored with the 'Game Changers Graduates' award in recognition of competitive excellence and pioneering representation across the national and international scene. Throughout this period, I reached top regional standings. 

Beyond competition, I worked closely with club leadership, high-profile stakeholders (including professional footballer David de Gea at Rebels Gaming), and marketing teams to elevate brand presence, handle media relations, and support corporate sponsorship initiatives.

A curated collection of press coverage, media articles, and interviews documenting key milestones from this era can be accessed inside the 'Links' folder.
